The other Maven skills are generic references and are not directly implicated by the task hints.","diagnosed_skills":[{"path":"maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md","confidence":"0.95","diagnosis":"The workflow guidance is incomplete and partially ambiguous for real CI repair scenarios. It does not clearly define the preferred build toolchain selection order (mvnw vs system mvn), how to identify the correct build entrypoint in legacy or nested repositories, or when to use test, verify, or install phases. The skill also lacks precise instructions for multi-module and nested integration-test projects (such as Maven Invoker or src/it fixtures), including how dependency resolution should be handled, how local repository population affects nested builds, and which directories are safe to modify. Existing examples rely on placeholders and assumptions that can encourage overbuilding unrelated modules or editing generated fixture projects under target directories.","repair_instruction":"Revise maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md to provide a precise CI repair workflow for legacy and nested Maven builds. Explicitly define toolchain selection order: prefer repository-provided ./mvnw when present, otherwise use system mvn, and document recording Java/Maven versions and optional toolchains usage only when required. Clarify reproduction sequencing and escalation rules for clean test, verify, install, -e, and -X, including when install is necessary to seed the local repository for downstream modules or integration tests. Add dedicated guidance for nested/invoker integration-test projects explaining dependency resolution strategy, use of -pl/-am for targeted builds, handling localRepo or cloned fixture projects, and avoiding edits to generated copies or embedded test fixtures unless they are actual version-controlled sources. Align all task artifact paths and placeholders with the benchmark contract and remove truncated or overly broad instructions that assume a single repository root or globally scoped dependency/plugin changes."}],"unselected_skills":["maven-dependency-management/SKILL.md","maven-plugin-configuration/SKILL.md"]}
